protocol.boundaries: Roots are disjoint from earlier train/dev/eval and reserved future roots. Intermediate inputs may overlap earlier primitive inputs; all such unique calls are counted. No data is used to update parameters.
protocol.budget: At most128x5=640 logical calls per condition,1280 across both. Cache identical primitive query/input calls within each condition, log actual unique calls, tokens and intermediate overlaps. Multi-call methods have extra inference budget.
protocol.generation: Native chat template with thinking disabled. Cue-only prompt, unrestricted full-vocabulary greedy generation, native model and tokenizer EOS, 32 new tokens per call. No grammar or choice restriction.
protocol.model_chain: Each primitive receives only the preceding model-produced JSON array. Invalid output terminates the chain. No oracle correction, rules, demonstrations, chat history or answer-conditioned context.
protocol.next_step_gate: Only consider chain-trace training if final model-chain accuracy>=.90, model-chain minus final one-shot>=.25, and final model-chain minus initial model-chain>=.25 on all128 queries. Any training requires a separate frozen protocol and disjoint inputs; this diagnostic launches none.
protocol.oracle_intermediate: Each primitive receives the exact oracle intermediate input. Report last-step accuracy and all-step accuracy separately; privileged diagnostic, not transfer evidence.
protocol.root_inputs: input_pool(37)[160:192], 32 unused roots. Reserve indices192:224. Every root is evaluated with all four ordered noncommuting pairs dax/wug,wug/dax,fep/kiv,kiv/fep.
protocol.scope: One fixture, two saved adapters, zero optimizer updates. Tests external decomposition of retained primitives; no internal compositional learning claim.
protocol.scoring: Whole-response JSON list of exactly four integers0..3. Exact executable final-answer accuracy; separately report the subset whose two orders have different answers. No substring extraction.
protocol.source_model: Reuse verified cached exact Qwen3.5-4B revision and original rank8/alpha16 BF16 adapter setup. Hash base and adapters before/after calls, reload each saved adapter exactly.
